android.desc:
Libracy is a powerful book tracker and reading app designed to help you track books, monitor your reading progress, and build lasting reading habits. Whether you need a comprehensive reading log, a digital reading journal, or a reliable reading tracker to manage your challenges, this reading app provides a clean and distraction-free experience.

───── TRACK YOUR LIBRARY ─────
• Book Tracker: Log books you are currently reading, want to read, or have finished.
• Barcode Scanner: Add physical books to your digital collection instantly using ISBN.
• 3D Bookshelf: Track books on an aesthetic, interactive, and immersive 3D shelf.
• Cloud Sync: Secure your reading log and library data with Google Drive backup.

───── BUILD BETTER HABITS ─────
• Reading Habits: Maintain daily streaks and monitor consistency over months.
• Page Tracker: Log your current page and sessions to see your reading velocity.
• Reading Goals: Set annual targets and join the reading challenge movement.
• Ambient Sounds: Enhance focus with library, rain, or fireplace soundscapes.

───── INSIGHTS & ANALYTICS ─────
• Reading Statistics: Explore detailed charts that reveal your genre preferences.
• OCR Quote Scanner: Capture wisdom from physical pages using AI text scanning.
• Reading Journal: Save excerpts and thoughts as beautiful digital cards.
• AMOLED Theme: Enjoy a pure black (#000000) design for eye comfort.

───── DESIGNED FOR READERS ─────
Libracy is a dedicated reading tracker built for book lovers, not algorithms. No social feeds, no annoying ads, no distractions — just you and your books. Enjoy a 100% ad-free book tracking app experience. This book tracking app is created to help you track books with joy and ease.

Available in 15+ languages to support the global reading community.

Track your first book in seconds. Start your reading tracker journey today!
